_about: Chemical Plant v0.21's anomaly smoke as 0.21d has it, numbers only (no switch is flipped: a flipped switch can ask for a shader variant 0.26g never shipped). The importer makes these three forward particles from a 0.26g template, whose values stayed where 0.21d's differ: radial_smoke plays its frame sequence at 1 for 0.21d's 0.5 (twice as fast); radial_smoke and smoke_sample glow at 0.25 for 0.21d's 1; green_smoke has the template's emissive map switched on where 0.21d has none, so its multiplier goes to 0. Values read from retail 0.21d's material_instances/fx/level_4_anomaly.
